_source: Number of tests of each suite of the four models, collected with `python -m scripts.run_all --update-baseline` (unittest discovery per suite). Regenerate only when tests are added or removed on purpose. Functional: 64 OPP-Split and 63 OPP-Mono (the 37 shared cases plus their own tests), 64 OPP-HC and 65 OPP-ACO (the 37 shared cases plus their own tests). Stress: the 19 shared scenarios per model.
